notes.title: Surreal Experience FREE!?!?!?
notes.notes:
You read the title right. Surreal Experience is now a [b]permanently completely free to play game[/b].

[h1]Why?[/h1]
Considering the game no longer receives updates, and since I've started my new visual novel project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2310440/cryspace/]Cryspace[/url], I figured now's a better time than ever to make the game permanently free. I loved making this game, I loved watching people play it, and now, everyone who's wanted to experience it can experience it for free.

[h1]My New Project[/h1]
As alluded to before, I've been spending my time working on my new game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2310440/cryspace/]Cryspace[/url]. Granted, it is nothing like Surreal Experience, but if you enjoy Surreal Experience and want to support more of my work, feel free to wish-list [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2310440/cryspace/]Cryspace[/url] and check it out when it releases on [b]October 1st[/b]!

[h1]In Conclusion...[/h1]
I hope you have fun with Surreal Experience. It was a super fun game for me to work on, and it was my introduction to game development as a whole. Give it a shot, and let me know what you think in the Community Forums, or by leaving a review.

Thank you,
[h2]JIMMY DIAMOND[/h2]

notes.title: A Surreal Halloween
notes.notes:
Halloween only comes once a year, and the cast of Surreal Experience isn't letting it pass them by!

Enjoy exploring the Office and Sunday School during this limited-time event. Every character (well, most of 'em anyway) has been redesigned with special Halloween costumes to tap into the true spirit of the holiday.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937914/1740460ade0a4073053b80f7e6b226c1fdb883e1.png[/img]
How can we forget the most important aspect of Halloween? Trick-or-treating! In both Office and Sunday School, candy can now be found around the map, which will give you a much-needed sugar rush in high pressure situations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937914/b42098fb6ab4d144829136c12630665e87ce3217.png[/img]
This event ends November 1st, so enjoy it while you can!

[h2]Have fun,[/h2]
[h1]JIMMY DIAMOND[/h1]

notes.title: Big Optimization Patch
notes.notes:
As a brief update, the game has been significantly optimized and updated with a few new additions.

[list]
[*]The Office level has been redesigned to make colors more vibrant as well as make the scenery more enticing outdoors. Upgrades have been added under the hood which results in a [b]10-20 time increase in performance.[/b]
[*]Fixed bugs in the Sunday School where some lights would cause shaders to glitch out.
[*]The tutorial has been redesigned, once again, from the ground up. This time, it takes the form of a guide, which provides useful information on everything in the game.
[/list]
This update refines the game significantly and makes it more playable for everyone. Try it out!

notes.title: New Map Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm excited to announce the upcoming release of a new map for the game: [i]Sunday School[/i]. This map will contain a whole new cast of characters, a whole new set of items, and some different mechanics as well to shake things up. Additionally, there will be a number of hidden rooms, areas, and secrets not before seen in Surreal Experience.

Here are some early screenshots of the map. Of course, this is subject to change, but this is what you can expect for right now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937914/3d5386a0002ea2162f890fbe2d97d554380a13f2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937914/0502b1561fd58d91c6ef7e001dff336decb0f045.png[/img]

As you may have guessed from some of these pictures, instead of kicking out homeless people, you will be "freeing" cult members, who've been manipulated and trapped into cells. Your objective will be to navigate the map in search of keys, and free these fellas out one-by-one until the job is done.

That's all I have for now that I'd like to publicly talk about. That being said, if you are interested in experiencing the Beta of this new level, please send me an email at jimmydiamond289@gmail.com with a screenshot of proof that you've beaten the Office level. This private beta will be available soon to anyone who is interested in pursuing it and wants to have an early look at the future of the game.

The release date for a public release will likely be in July or, at the very latest, August.

Thanks for your continued support, and those who have purchased the game during this year's Summer Sale.

[h2]Yours,[/h2]
[h1]JIMMY DIAMOND[/h1]

notes.title: More Game Modes Available Now!
notes.notes:
As a part of today's update, two new-game modes have been added.

[h1]Speedrun or Die[/h1]
In this game-mode, your primary goal is to get through the game as fast as possible, or face the consequences.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937914/fe7b981731f5c34e0c3bbbbd1936a156eb77f095.png[/img]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]All items are set to "Very Common".
[*]The longer you take, the more NPCs that spawn, and the more frequently they do.
[*]NPC spawns are random, and could be either the Thug, Crackhead, or Manager.
[*]Everything else is exactly the same.
[/list]
This game-mode is intended for players who know the game in-and-out, including the locations in which the homeless people spawn, where items generally spawn, etc. Lack of game knowledge equals guaranteed failure. Taking longer than about a minute and a half to speed through the game will make it extremely hard to beat.

[h1]Realistic Mode[/h1]
Ever wondered how Surreal Experience would play out if your ran at a normal speed and things were a bit more normal in general?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937914/8712502ab31ad724beb7b95b15407cfdd089f870.png[/img]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Walking/running speeds of the player, as well as all NPCs have been divided by 2.
[*]Homeless people now move around at a random speed and in random directions as opposed to standing completely still.
[*]The Manager is slightly nerfed in this mode.
[*]It is slightly harder to lose the Thug.
[*]Items that cannot normally be used towards the end of the game can now be used at any time.
[/list]
This mode is primarily intended for players who prefer slower paced games, and also really just to demonstrate how the game would look if it weren't for the crazy speed that all the other modes have. That being said, with these adjustments, it brings its own unique set of difficulties to the table, which may require you to take a different strategy than what is effective in the other modes.

These modes are a bit more abstract than the ones found in the previous update, so have fun with them! Additionally, there are 2 more achievements to be unlocked for completing them. Good luck, and have fun!

[h1]Next Update[/h1]
This concludes the addition of any new game-modes for the foreseeable future. Work will now go towards finishing the second level of the game, which will take about 2-3 months to finish. I'll be leaking some information about it probably next month or so. Additionally, I will be focusing my attention towards optimizing the game to achieve higher frame rates as well as fixing some bugs/providing some quality of life improvements.

[h2]Enjoy,[/h2]
[h1]JIMMY DIAMOND[/h1]

notes.title: Sandbox and Hardcore Mode Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h1]Intro[/h1]

Welcome back to Surreal Experience. Today's update includes an all-new Sandbox game-mode to allow for complete customization over the game, and a new Hardcore game-mode for those who want a grueling challenge. Both game-modes are accessible from the main menu under "Bonus Modes" and are playable regardless of whether you've beaten the regular mode or not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937914/814a1f7fa7824a2da87a7413fda4272e0bbe7afe.png[/img]

[h1]Sandbox Mode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937914/bf9c61cec4593566366e7d2b6ba46020273c7e02.png[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Customize the game to your exact liking with different variables.
[*]Spawn as low as 1 or up to 20 homeless people to search for and kick out.
[*]Spawn up to 7 Thugs, Managers, and/or Crackheads for your run, or completely disable them! (excluding Thug)
[*]Adjust the difficulty of NPCs to either be in Normal or Hardcore mode.
[*]Control the amount of items that spawn in, ranging from very rare to very common.
[/list]
Sandbox Mode gives you the freedom to make the game as easy, difficult, or absurd as you'd like with minimal restriction. Have fun!

[h1]Hardcore Mode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937914/8c6e7b6ae36af369c858ba5557170a6cfb572b21.png[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Play through a challenging mode in which items are scarce, and NPCs are harder.
[*]The Thug will run into you more often, and has a faster moving speed than in Normal mode.
[*]The Crackhead will chase you from a further distance to confront you, and will annoy you more often.
[*]The Manager is much less tolerable, and will make it his mission to impede your progress. Any slight break in your work, and he'll haul towards you with a verbal warning.
[*]Like in the Normal mode, this mode also keeps track of your best time upon completion.
[/list]
This mode is [b]much more difficult[/b] and [b]much less forgiving[/b] than the normal game, and requires technique and finesse at a level in which only Surreal Experience seasoned veterans could even hope to complete. Good luck.

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
This update breathes a lot more life into the game and allows you to play it any way you want, giving you a re-playable, fun experience you can keep coming back to without it getting stale. I have some great ideas for some additional game-modes as well, so you'll be seeing 2 new ones released in about a month's time. After this, work will move towards completing the second level of the game, which I'll be teasing sometime soon once the ideas come more into fruition.

Thank you for your support thus far, and I hope you enjoy the new game-modes! As always, please post on the discussion forums or get in touch with me directly if you notice any problems with this version of the game.

[h2]Yours,[/h2]
[h1]JIMMY DIAMOND [/h1]

notes.title: Game Progress Update
notes.notes:
I wanted to take some time and give an announcement as to where the game is headed as I understand updates have been scarce. The reason for this is that currently, I am working on adding an entire new map as well as various new features such as Sandbox and Hardcore mode.

The primary goal for development right now is to finish the game practically in its entirety to offer an experience in which will be fully feature-fledged, re-playable, customizable, and fun to the vast majority of players. Understand that even the Office level took some time to create to offer, what I believe to be anyway, the perfect blend of difficulty, unpredictability, and a bittersweet experience that is both fun and frustrating. I would like to achieve the same thing with the next level on a larger scale, and this will, of course, take me some time, especially as I am the sole developer of this game.

The other features, such as the aforementioned new modes, shouldn't take me nearly as long, but I obviously want to make sure that those are working well once they're developed, and I'll need to ensure that I have testers to have a look at that stuff and make sure it's good to go and bug-free before release.

The primary goal here is to have a game I can consider "done". Will more developments come after this upcoming update? Quite possibly, yes, as I'd like to do even more to the game, but I also don't want for it to be convoluted with half-baked ideas either, so I think this update will provide more than enough content.

Thanks for being patient, and you can expect this update within the upcoming months.

notes.title: Surreal Experience Officially Released!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Surreal Experience, and thank you all for your interest and patience leading up to this pivotal moment. [b]The game is now officially released in Early Access[/b], and I'm very excited to hear what you all think of it.

[h1]Game Features as of Launch[/h1]
[list]
[*]A tough-as-nails experience that requires a balanced combination of skill, luck, inventory management, and wits.
[*]Play through the Office map, which supports random generation of items and NPCs.
[*]Built-in timer for speedrunning support. Also keeps track of your best time!
[*]Find and use three different items - smoke some crack, wear a disguise, or use a hearing aid to echolocate homeless people.
[*]Run into many different NPCs, all with their own unique personalities and interactions.
[*]Steam achievements that support both beating the game as well as many hidden achievements that you'll have to uncover.
[/list]
This is only the beginning. A whole new map is already in the works and will be, of course, provided for free for all players. You can expect to see a bundle of new features and Easter eggs which will creep their way into new versions of the game all the way up until our launch out of Early Access.

I'd like to thank everyone who has tested, wishlisted, and curated the game. I appreciate all of the great comments as well as constructive criticism I've received whilst developing this game. Without all of you, this game wouldn't be possible, and it certainly wouldn't be what it is up to this point.

As the game is in Early Access, please do understand that there may be bugs/unexpected behavior that occurs throughout your playthroughs. If anything like this occurs, please use our discussion forums to report what happened as well as how it happened so I can do my best to fix it for you!

Additionally, if you have any ideas in terms of new items, new NPCs, etc. I'd be happy to hear them. As mentioned in my Early Access header on the Store Page, I'm very receptive to all kinds of criticism or suggestions, and anything you may suggest that makes sense to add will likely find its way into the game. My goal is to create something truly special that you will have fun playing, and will want to share with your friends to see how well they fare in this truly difficult game.

Thank you again, and I look forward to seeing how well you fare against your opposition ːhappy_creepː.

Yours,
[h1]JIMMY DIAMOND[/h1]
